description: app-spec source write guard: denies file writes under the analysed app and each contract repository named in app-spec.json, and asks before shell commands that would write there. A no-op where no app-spec.json is found. Turn it off with the plugin option guard=false (APP_SPEC_GUARD=false in Devin). Matches Claude Code's tool names and Devin's. Under Devin only, a session-start note says how to read the skills there.
